content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the old terraces and stone paths where the valley opens wide below."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the cobbled lanes where artisans keep old crafts alive, and maybe find a farewell treasure."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Follow cacao from bean to bar, with a sweet chance to taste the highlands' favourite treat."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The market hums with colour, spice and stories; let the fruit ladies charm you."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The plaza wraps you in stone arches and Andean light, perfect for a first wander."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cristo Blanco watches over the red rooftops; the view makes the short climb worth it."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Green Point serves plant-based comfort that even a hungry alpaca would approve of."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The old Inca walls still hold the light beautifully, and the stonework tells its own story."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Step inside for the grand altars and a quiet moment away from the plaza bustle."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A refined take on Andean flavours, with thoughtful plates for the vegetarians among you."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Huge stones fitted like a puzzle, with wide views over the city and good photo spots."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Small but rich collection of Inca artefacts, textiles and goldwork to round out the history."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cosy, casual and easy on the wallet, with solid vegetarian comfort food."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the terraces and stonework where the old ones watched Inti (the sun) rise over the valley."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Those circular terraces look like a giant green amphitheatre carved for the wind."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Thousands of salt pans glitter on the hillside like snow that forgot to melt."}]}
Cusco welcomes, the Inca heart beats, the Sacred Valley shines under Inti (the sun), then a warm artisan goodbye.
